Strategy: Reward absolute post-placement residuals between twenty and thirty-five, and penalize residuals between five and twelve, keeping leftovers in a proven useful middle range. It may help by steering bins toward mid-size leftovers, but may fail if the fixed edges do not match the item sizes in play.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 20 and r - item <= 35 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 5 and r - item <= 12 else 0) for r in bins]
```
